PitchRank offers free access to its youth soccer rankings. Users can browse rankings for any state, age group, or team without requiring an account or payment. The platform also provides a "Free Team Report Card," which is a PDF containing a team's national and state rank, PowerScore, record, and last five games.

While browsing rankings and obtaining team report cards are free, PitchRank's Terms of Service mention a "digital subscription platform" and "subscription access controls", and it refers to "advanced features for registered users". This suggests that there may be premium features or a paid subscription tier available beyond the free offerings, although the core ranking data remains free to view.
